title: HoneyBees [StationAPI]
description: Adds real-size bees, beehives, honey glazed food, honey sweets and honeycomb blocks. It's a stand-alone version of Foodies 1.1 update features.
body:
# HoneyBees
Stand-alone HoneyBees mod from my main mod **[Foodies](https://modrinth.com/mod/foodies)** including most of features from 1.1 update. 

Built for Minecraft **Beta 1.7.3** and **StationAPI**.


<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/XnksRmGOnZs" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

## Added Features:
- Beehive
- Wild bee nest - found in trunk of oak or birch trees
- Bees - produce honey overtime, has day-night cycle
- Honey
- Glazed food - porchop, fish and apple in honey glaze, they heal slightly more
- Honey cookies and candies
- Honeycomb block - just decorating block
- Jar - used to catch bees

![All added items](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a87cac323272f5d00aea18db79854b36b092c424.png)

## Required dependencies

- **[StationAPI](https://modrinth.com/mod/stationapi)**
- **[FarnUtil](https://modrinth.com/mod/farnutil)**
- **[Glass Config API](https://modrinth.com/mod/glass-config-api)** - Required only to change default mod config.

<details>
<summary>Mod config with GCAPI</summary>


- Wild bee nests generation rarity
- Amount of bee particle generation
- If bees are rendered on flowers
- Bee buzzing sound volume
</details>


## Compatibility

- **[BH Creative](https://modrinth.com/mod/bh-creative)** - HoneyBees has own creative tab with every new item.
- **[Always More Items](https://modrinth.com/mod/always-more-items)** - Recomended to use to see all the recipes added by HoneyBees.
